seller_feedback.feedback_text: Order delivered on time with no issues

I ordered an rx6400 GPU from this seller. The seller then contacted me within a day and notified me that there was a mistake on the listing and that it should have been listed as an Nvidia T1000, which is a significantly more expensive card averaging $100. More than the rx6400. They then shipped me the more expensive T1000 GPU at the price I paid for the rx6400. You rarely see this kind of honesty from companies these days and I would 100 % suggest this seller to anyone.

Fantastic seller. Superior and professional communication. This Z440 arrived within a few days, safely packaged in a hefty and well-padded box with their company logo. I will definitely buy again from this seller! Computer arrived in great condition and was exactly as described. I’ve been running the computer 24hrs a day for about a week with no issues. BIOS was unlocked. I added a graphics card, boot SSD, and OS. All drivers installed with no exclamation icons or warnings. Thank you so much!

Shipped quickly and arrived very well packaged. The tower was extremely clean inside and exactly as described. The seller answered all of my questions promptly and professionally. After several days of stress testing, I haven't found a single issue. The unexpected extras made my transition to Windows 11 Pro easy, and the system handles my GTX 1080 Ti flawlessly. Highly recommend this company for their communication, packaging, and quality product.

Excellent seller. Extremely fast shipping—the server arrived only two days after I ordered. Build quality and overall quality are excellent, and it arrived exactly as described. The appearance is outstanding; it looks almost brand new and was exceptionally clean. Packaging was excellent, with expanding foam protecting the server extremely well. Drive blanks and RAM blanks were included as a bonus. Excellent condition and value. Would absolutely buy again. Will absolutely use this sell again! A++

Very pleased with this purchase. The Dell Precision T7910 with two Xeon E5-2697 v3 CPUs (28 cores) arrived quickly and was packed carefully, which matters with a machine this heavy. It came exactly as listed, in good physical condition, and booted and POSTed without issues once I added RAM and a drive. The seller was responsive and easy to deal with. Would gladly buy from them again.

I want to say .... for such a large and heavy item these sellers shipped it LIGHTNING fast!! Like 3 days from order and payment to it on my doorstep!
